content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for UBKV Research Scholar Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya (UBKV), located in Cooch Behar, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in UBKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification is Research Scholar under a project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Scholar post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Scholar position in Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for UBKV Research Scholar?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected based on a walk-in-interview conducted directly before a designated selection committee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the UBKV Research Scholar recruitment is scheduled to take place on 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Seed Science, Plant Physiology, Plant Science, or related disciplines to be eligible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for the Research Scholar position?
faq.answer: Applicants must be below 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories like SC/ST.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary/stipend offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Scholar position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.00.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates need to apply online before attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, this is a walk-in interview recruitment where eligible candidates can directly report to the venue with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring two copies of applications, a detailed bio-data, attested photocopies and originals of all academic certificates, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.
